Four hoisted runComp calls: baseline; all-magnitudes-x10; all-slots-emptied; burst-probe. The fixed B3 (helm) is kept ON: claire has no crit/normal-attack scoping for helm's buffs to confound, and it keeps the chain healthy. NOTE ON A PACKET INCONSISTENCY: the shape cheat-sheet says each override slot is a CharacterSkills carrying its own `blocks` array (ov.skill1!.blocks), while the OVERRIDE FILE SHAPE section says each slot IS a Block[] (iterate override.skill1). Both agree there is no top-level `blocks`. The test's getBlocks/setBlocks helpers read and write EITHER shape, so no assertion depends on which is right. NOTE ON THE BURST FIXTURE: claire is Burst I and liter (also Burst I) occupies the fixture's B1 slot, so the rotation may never select claire — if the non-vacuity probe test is the only red, the finding is about the fixture (skill2 + burst are unexercised by any controlComp-based suite for a second-B1 unit), not about the override.
gaps: burst 'Removes 1 debuff(s)' — it.skip: the effect schema has no cleanse/debuff-removal primitive, and the scope-lock boss applies no debuffs, so the line is unobservable and unmodelable; asserted only as an unmodeled-record entry.

Heals and shields have NO event kind on cfg.onEvent (documented kinds: shot/damage/buffApply/buffRemove/reload/burstCast/fullBurstStart/fullBurstEnd). Neither the 2.86% / 34.35% heals nor the 10.13% shield can be asserted directly at the sim boundary; every heal/shield check here is structural, or a counterfactual chosen to be robust to that blindness.

The effect-schema union supplied in this packet contains no 'heal' variant, yet the `recovery` trigger's own doc-comment says it fires when 'a heal effect targets them'. Claire's two heal lines are therefore asserted by magnitude-preservation + not-a-stat-buff rather than by an exact effect kind, since the faithful kind name cannot be determined from the packet.

Whether claire's skill1 heal actually reaches crown (the fixture's `recovery` consumer) is target-set dependent — skill1 heals only the top-2 FINAL-ATK allies, and crown is a Supporter — so no cross-unit tandem magnitude is asserted; only the direction-only inertness bound is.
